annotations.title: Find programs or read one state nomination occupation list

description: Without program, discover the full exact state/visaSubclass/program directory (optionally filter visaSubclass); page has no meaning in directory mode. With program and visaSubclass, verify the exact identity and read one official or national baseline list, 40 records per page. A list match is not personal eligibility. Unknown projects are errors; successful empty known lists are no_data.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

program.description: Exact API program name previously returned by this MCP in the current conversation, with its state/visaSubclass identity. Otherwise first call get_state_nomination_occupations without program. User-provided pathway names, abbreviations or translations are not verified API identities.

name: get_state_nomination_occupations
title: Find programs or read one state nomination occupation list
